description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

>若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value may be different for each API request.

description.zh:
QoS策略所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the QoS policy.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the region ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-express-connect-traffic-qos-queue --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --queue-id-list qos-queue-9nyx2u7n71s2rc0000 --queue-name-list qos-queue-test --qos-id qos-2giu0a6vd5x0mv0000 --region cn-hangzhou
